run_finetuning_training: run the finetuning loop for a Contriever model with optimizer, scheduler, and evaluation checkpoints
run_evaluate_model: run evaluation of a Contriever model computing accuracy and MRR on a dataset
run_main_entry: run the main entry point to initialize distributed training and start finetuning a retriever model
review_finetuning_function: review the finetuning function that handles training loops, logging, SAM optimization, and periodic evaluation
review_evaluate_function: review the evaluate function that computes accuracy and MRR using in-batch negative sampling
